title: Parallel scaling with binary task rewards

x_axis.label: Parallel training environments
x_axis.note: K denotes 1024 environments. These are separate training conditions, not successive training times.

calculation.mean: Arithmetic mean of the five per-seed success percentages
calculation.sd: Sample standard deviation of the five per-seed success percentages (ddof=1)
calculation.weighting: Equal weight per asset within each seed; 32 trials for each of 19 assets
calculation.error_bar_interpretation: Variation across evaluation seeds, not independent training seeds, standard error, or confidence intervals

protocol.reset_distribution: Uniform within each asset in the same frozen mixed-reset bank, including partially assembled starting states
protocol.success: First full assembly without a simultaneous safety failure; incomplete episodes fail at 15 seconds
protocol.sampler_comparison: The curves differ in training reset sampling; their evaluation reset sampling and frozen bank are shared
protocol.scale_comparison: Parallel environments, GPUs, and rollout batch size increase together at a fixed training iteration count

notes: The current plot reads evaluation counts, not the legacy scaling_data.csv training-log values or corrections.
Preserve the observed uniform-sampling dip at 64K; do not force a monotonic curve.
Connecting lines and animation order visualize the measurements and are not additional observations.
